messages:
maria: heads-up — I can reproduce a case on prod where users with the "viewer" role see the "Edit project" button on some project pages. Seems limited to projects created before the RBAC migration. Not all projects. I have one repro: /projects/p-1234. Screenshot: https://.../img.png

maria: dmitri: hmm. which migration run? the rolebinding transform that ran yesterday? @deploy-bot can you confirm the deploy and migration ID?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-19T22:14 UTC: console service deployed (rev a1b2c3). Migration job: rbac-rolebinding-transform v2 executed as post-deploy hook. No automatic rollback triggered.

jen: if this is tied to that migration we should pause rollout to dedicated/private immediately until we triage. @security-bot add this to triage list.

security-bot: Alert created: console.rbac.anomaly — project_edit_visibility spike +32% since rbac-rolebinding-transform v2. Sample project ids: p-1234, p-9876, p-5543.

maria: repro steps I used:
1) login as user with role="viewer" on team="platform"
2) visit /projects/p-1234
3) observe "Edit project" visible in header

Quick API check:
```
GET /api/v1/projects/p-1234/permissions?user=uid:1001
resp: {"can_edit": true, "roles":["viewer"], "bindings":["legacy:team:platform"]}
```
KMS logs: I checked key access around 2026-03-19T22:14 — there's no matching envelope for the rolebinding write that would indicate a separate key usage; suspicious.

dmitri: can you paste the migration transform? I'm worried we special-cased owner==null paths. Might have accidentally promoted team viewers to project editors.

maria: from the migration job logs (snippet):
```
transform_project_role(p):
  if p.owner == null: assign binding "project:viewer" to project.team
  elif p.owner in team: assign binding "project:editor" to project.team_members
```
Looks like the second branch uses "project:editor" for team_members while the first assigns "project:viewer" — but downstream permission resolution conflates "project:viewer" when owner missing, due to a legacy grant mapping we forgot to remove.

jen: immediate mitigations:
- add a platform-side policy that explicitly denies project.edit if resolved_role=="viewer" (short-term guard).
- feature-flag kill-switch on migration-derived bindings.
- request audit export of all projects touched by the job.

audit-leads: I can run a targeted audit: list all projects where migration job wrote a binding and produce KMS envelope timestamps for those DB writes. ETA ~2 hours. Also will check who performed any manual writes.

dmitri: I'll add a unit/integration test for owner==null path and prepare a rollback migration script that reverts bindings written by job id rbac-rolebinding-transform v2. Assigning to me.

maria: ops: can we push the deny_policy hotfix to canary now? If it blocks edit UI we can buy time.

deploy-bot: Hotfix patch (console.rbac-deny-viewer-edit) queued: 2026-03-20T01:10 UTC — deploying to canary group now. Monitor channel: eng-oncall.

jen: also, add a monitoring alert that fires when resolved_edit_permission != expected for a viewer binding. We need to catch regressions earlier.

security-bot: Note for postmortem — correlate any edit actions on the affected projects with KMS key_ids and audit log envelopes. We need to confirm no unauthorized write activity.

maria: will compile affected project list (from audit-leads) and post to #incidents and to this thread when ready.

dmitri: thanks — will update with PR/rollback. Keep small updates here. :thumbsup:
